sentences.text: The box was by Chip's bed.
Biff and Chip looked at the box.
They opened the box and looked inside.
A key was in the box.
Biff picked up the magic key and the magic began.
Biff and Chip got smaller and smaller and smaller.
Biff and Chip looked at the house.
It looks like a big house.
Biff pushed and pushed, but she couldn't get in.
Chip pulled and pulled, but he couldn't get in.
Biff and Chip looked at the mouse.
The mouse looked at Biff and Chip.
Biff and Chip got bigger and bigger and bigger.
